Restore files.

## Synopsis

```text
restore [where=<where>] [client=<client>] [storage=<storage>]
        [bootstrap=<bootstrap>] [restorejob=<restorejob>] [comment=<comment>]
        [jobid=<jobid>[,...]] [fileset=<fileset>]
        [replace=<always|ifnewer|ifolder|never>]
        [pluginoptions=<pluginoptions>] [regexwhere=<regexwhere>]
        [fileregex=<fileregex>] [restoreclient=<restoreclient>]
        [backupformat=<backupformat>] [pool=<pool>] [file=<file> ...]
        [directory=<directory> ...] [before[=<before>]]
        [strip_prefix=<strip_prefix>] [stripprefix=<stripprefix>]
        [add_prefix=<add_prefix>] [addprefix=<addprefix>]
        [add_suffix=<add_suffix>] [addsuffix=<addsuffix>] [select[=<select>]]
        [current] [copies] [archive] [done] [all] [job=<job>] [yes]
        [catalog=<catalog>]
```

Words without brackets are required, `[ ]` marks optional parts, `a | b` alternatives, `...` a repeatable argument and `[,...]` a comma separated list.

## Description

Selects files from backups and starts a restore job. Without a selection the Director shows the selection menu; \`done\` ends the file selection.

## Examples

Restore everything of a client:

```text
restore client=fd select current all done yes where=/tmp/r
```

Open the selection menu:

```text
restore
```

Restore all files of job 42 to a separate directory:

```text
restore jobid=42 client=bareos-fd restorejob=RestoreFiles where=/tmp/bareos-restores all done yes
```

Restore a single file from the latest backup:

```text
restore client=bareos-fd restorejob=RestoreFiles file=/etc/fstab where=/tmp/bareos-restores yes
```
